name: Ergo
description: A highly customisable Task Management app that helps you plan your day.
notes: Timeboxing: drag a task onto a time in the calendar to pin it there, and drag its bottom edge to set when it ends; a pinned task keeps its time and shows as late when the day runs over
Ergo no longer comes with a copy of the snippet; install it from Settings, About
In a short window the welcome tour keeps its normal text size and scrolls
